examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The band as the customers page places it: the overline and headline over a nine-mark logo wall, with one signed quote from Zoop in the aside and a link out to its case study. Edit the props in the Controls panel — a band with no logos and no quote renders only its title.

examples.name: Quote band
examples.summary: `variant="quote"` sets the quote alone as a full-width band, with no logos: the design sample's QuoteBand. `quote-variant="highlight"` gives it the featured register with the mark beside the text.

examples.name: Registry
examples.summary: The wall built straight from the client registry: each entry's light/dark pair, or its single file with the `artwork` that says which theme inverts it, is drawn right on both themes by `ThirdPartyLogo`; the quote's company mark comes from the registry too, and an outlined `secondary-action` sits beside the primary one.
